exposure: Preeclampsia timing (preterm preeclampsia vs. term preeclampsia)
cohort: The study included 174 pregnant women (84 with preeclampsia, 90 healthy controls) selected from a larger cohort of 421, all in their third trimester.
finding: Plasma ferritin and albumin levels reflected higher inflammation in cases with preeclampsia compared with healthy pregnancies, while plasma transferrin and hs-CRP levels showed significant differences between preterm and term preeclampsia, demonstrating potential as diagnostic markers.
cross-section timing: During the third trimester, on the day of inclusion.
gest_age: Third trimester, with comparisons between preterm and term preeclampsia categories.
